failures.label: solid_line_crossing
failures.why: A bus body overhangs the solid line while turning; its box bottom-centre crosses but the wheels do not.

failures.label: fire_smoke
failures.why: Headlight glare on wet asphalt reads as smoke for 5 s before real smoke appears; tIoU 0.95 still, but it would fail on a short event.

failures.label: road_obstacle
failures.why: A cardboard box is not a COCO class, so the detector never proposes it.

failures.label: red_light
failures.why: At night the red lamp saturates to white; the light state flips 1.5 s late, so tIoU drops to 0.57.
